'''Onslaught''' is a non-stackable [[buff]]. {{c|help|Onslaught Grants 20% increased Attack, Cast and Movement Speed}}. 

__TOC__

==Mechanics==
Onslaught can be scaled by {{c|mod|#% increased Onslaught Effect}} modifiers, such as those found on {{il|Daresso's Defiance}} or an [[Axe Mastery|Axe mastery]], and [[Buff Effect|buff effect]] modifiers (e.g. {{il|Ichimonji}}). Onslaught granted from a {{il|Silver Flask}} can be scaled with flask duration and effect modifiers.

Buffs that grant Onslaught by default have a 4 second duration. This duration can be refreshed from the gaining the buff again from a buff source.<ref name="effects" /> Onslaught duration cannot be modified by skill [[duration]] modifiers.

==Ruthless mode==
Onslaught does not grant [[movement speed]] in [[Ruthless mode]]. The tooltip instead reads {{c|help|Onslaught Grants 20% increased Attack and Cast Speed}}.

==Trivia==
Onslaught as an area mod was a mechanic during [[Onslaught league]]. This was not added to the core game. However, it was briefly available as a {{il|Map Device}} crafted mod such as during [[version 3.0.0|version 3.0]], [[version 3.2.0|version 3.2]] and  [[version 3.4.0|version 3.4]]. Version 3.4.X was the last appearance of such Map Device crafted mod. Since it is not available with the allocation of [[The Seventh Gate]] and [[version 3.24.0]], this mod will likely not return to the core game. Certain [[event]] and [[race]] may enable this area mod, however.
